caption: The drawing shows a single brass door knocker mounted against a plain beige background. The door knocker has an oval plate with ornate detailing, and the surface of the plate displays the intertwined initials "MH" engraved in the center. Above the oval plate, there is a decorative finial that forms the topmost part of the object. Below the oval plate, the bottom part of the knocker is curved, forming a semi-circular handle that attaches at two points, with a small circular medallion at the bottom containing the number "182". The metallic surface of the knocker has variations in tone to indicate a brass material, with shadowing on the right side that suggests a light source from the left. To the right and just below the knocker, there is a handwritten signature that reads "W.L. Antrim."
title: Door Knocker
